headline: New York's record bridge opens
post_facts: 4,260 ft main span, the world's longest in 1964
Its towers lean apart for Earth's curve

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in nineteen sixty-four... New York opened a bridge built around the curve of the Earth.

scenes.label: New York City
scenes.caption: Photographed in 1964
scenes.title: Brooklyn to Staten Island
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] The Verrazzano-Narrows Bridge linked Brooklyn and Staten Island.

scenes.label: main span, the longest in the world
scenes.text: [calmly] Its main span ran four thousand two hundred sixty feet... the longest in the world.

scenes.label: Between the towers
scenes.caption: Photo: MTA Bridges and Tunnels
scenes.title: Towers that follow the Earth
scenes.text: [softly] Its towers are more than an inch and a half farther apart at the top, because the Earth curves.
